data.name: Trapped Out
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Trapped out!, a fun and crazy party game to play with family and friends. Create chaos, fun and laughter while you duke it out with your friends to see who can win in this insane family friendly 3D battle arena game!

Key Features:

  • Crazy Weapons and Wild Effects: Throw down with your friend but burning them with flamethrowers, hitting them with doors and even giving them a smack across the face with a giant hand!. Go for that Victory!

  • Local Multiplayer: Go back to the good old days of couch coop where you could sit and have fun with your family and friends without worrying about internet and all that stuff. Let the wonderful feeling of couch coop take you back to a simpler time!

    Please note this game is only local multiplayer and supports 2 to 4 Players, there is no Single player mode.

  • Unlockable Costumes: Kit your player out with tonnes of fun and crazy outfits!, the more you play the more costumes you unlock! Lets be honest, looking stylish is already a victory!

  • Family Friendly Fun: With trapped outs colourful graphics, light-hearted gameplay and simple 2 button gameplay this is the perfect game to play with all members of the family. From your younger brother up to your grandma, everyone can have fun in this zany game!

  • Dynamic 3D Arenas: Fight across vibrant and interactive 3D arena’s Specifically made to both help and hinder you in your goal of being the strongest in the arena! From falling trees to spinning lasers, enjoy the chaos and use it to your advantage!

Join the Battle now!

Dive into Trapped out and experience just joy of the “good old days” laughing and battling your family and friends in this chaotic game! We look forward to seeing you in Trapped out!

Please note!

This game is purely a local multiplayer gamepad game, you require two connected gamepads to play this game!
